entities.name: Akinori Ōtsuka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Akinori Otsuka  is a Japanese former baseball pitcher who coaches for the Chunichi Dragons in Nippon Professional Baseball. He was the setup man for the San Diego Padres and the Texas Rangers. He was also the closer for Japan's 2006 World Baseball Classic–winning team.
